QUOTE: The assembly is gated by `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`, which is defined only under `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` and only when the compiler is GCC-compatible or ARMCC (`constant_time_impl.h:40-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined only under MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM and when the compiler is GCC-compatible or ARMCC. That describes it as derived from HAVE_ASM plus compiler detection. It never says outright that it is not set in mbedtls_config.h.
